title: noksha.json
description: Configuration for @noksha-ui/cli. Written by `noksha init`; read by `add` and `diff`.

$schema.description: This file, so editors offer completion and validation.

registry.description: Base URL of the component registry. Point it at a fork to serve your own components.

brand.description: The seed colour the stylesheet was generated from — hex, rgb() or oklch(). Changing it needs `noksha init --force` to regenerate the CSS.

css.description: The stylesheet Tailwind compiles, relative to the project root. `init` writes noksha.css beside it and adds the @import.

components.description: Where components are written, relative to the project root.

alias.description: Import prefix for cross-directory imports between copied files. Null falls back to relative paths, which need no tsconfig support.

tsx.description: Whether the project compiles TypeScript. The components are TypeScript either way; this records whether they will typecheck.

installed.description: What `add` wrote, and from which upstream revision. This is the record that lets `diff` tell a local edit apart from an upstream change — keep it in version control.

hash.description: The registry's whole-component hash at the time it was copied.

files.description: Per-file hash of the content written, keyed by path relative to the components directory.
